# Name constraints / EKU test fixtures

These DER certificates are generated by
`dev/generate_name_constraint_fixtures.sh` (which uses
`dev/name_constraints_openssl.cnf`). Re-run that script to regenerate the set.

Hierarchy:

- `nc_root.crt` - trust anchor of the custom hierarchy.
- `nc_dns_ca.crt` - permitted DNS subtree `example.com`.
- `nc_ip_ca.crt` - permitted IP subtrees `10.0.0.0/8` and `2001:db8::/32`.
- `nc_idna_ca.crt` - permitted IDNA (A-label) DNS subtree.
- `nc_excluded_dns_ca.crt` - excluded DNS subtree `forbidden.example.com`.
- `nc_uri_ca.crt` - permitted URI subtree `.example.com` (sub-domains only).
- `nc_eku_ca.crt` - EKU restricted to clientAuth and emailProtection.
- `ee_*.crt` - end-entity certificates exercising SAN, CN, IDNA, IP and URI
  name forms, plus an EKU intersection conflict.
